implementation_notes.sdk_availability: anthropic library NOT installed in this environment; SDK path implemented and probed at runtime via _probe_sdk(); falls back to dry-run simulation gracefully
implementation_notes.dry_run_mode: full structural validation without API calls; all 8 tests pass in dry-run
implementation_notes.asyncio_pattern: Python 3.11+ asyncio.TaskGroup for structured concurrency (W1/W2 inline); asyncio.create_task for W3 background
implementation_notes.rate_limiting: TokenBucketRateLimiter (2.0 rps default) gates all API calls; tune via rate_limit_rps param
implementation_notes.atomic_writes: temp file + os.rename() on POSIX; fsync before rename; collision-resistant counter in filename
implementation_notes.coc_integrity: 4x_coc_writer.py subprocess call after every manifest write; failure is logged but non-fatal (manifest already committed)
implementation_notes.bundle_composition: role-aware via agent card injection; honey_content/nectar_content can be overridden per spawn; TTL cache (5min) on NECTAR reads
implementation_notes.manifest_parse: extracts dashboard_line + compass_edge + quality_score + belief_index from agent output via fenced ```manifest``` block or JSON scan fallback
implementation_notes.retry_pattern: exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s; unrecoverable errors (AuthenticationError, BadRequestError) abort immediately
implementation_notes.self_test_results: 8/8 tests pass: AgentRunID uniqueness, BundleComposer, ManifestWriter atomic, AgentSpawner dry-run, W1 parallel, config validation, bundle validation, three-wave session
